title: Kiln project record
description: The one Kiln-owned file that IS committed: a stable non-secret project identifier and the project's non-secret capability choices. ⚠️ IT IS COMMITTED, WHICH DECIDES EVERYTHING ELSE ABOUT IT. Every field here reaches every clone, so nothing host-specific and nothing secret may appear: no credential, no consent, no path, no username, no machine name. The operator's permission to use THIS machine's connections lives in the ignored consent record precisely so that cloning a project does not clone somebody's approval. ⚠️ IT DELIBERATELY CARRIES NO TIMESTAMP. When this file appeared is something version control already records, and a second copy in the file is a parallel claim that can disagree with the first.

projectId.description: Created once and never regenerated. ⚠️ A MISSING OR CONFLICTING ID IS A RECOVERY DECISION, NOT A REGENERATION (section 7): it also keys the browser health identity and the external user-local state root, so quietly minting a new one would orphan a state directory and make a running supervisor's identity check fail against its own project.

research.description: The project's committed research choice. ⚠️ A CHOICE, NEVER A CREDENTIAL, AND NEVER AN AUTHORISATION. `provider: "tavily"` records that this project intends to use Tavily; it does not record that anyone may. Whether THIS host's credential may be used is a separate grant in the ignored consent record, which is what stops a clone inheriting one operator's approval (section 6.5).

provider.description: `none` is a real recorded choice — research deliberately disabled — and is distinct from the field being absent, which means nobody has decided yet.
